_metadata.description: Multiple encrypted backup destinations backed by kopia repositories with vault-sourced secrets.

requirements.title: Multiple destinations as kopia repositories
requirements.description: Create and manage multiple destinations, each a kopia repository of a given kind (local filesystem, S3/MinIO). A destination must not be allowed to point under the storage root it would protect.

validation.notes: Create fs + S3 destinations; assert connect/status; assert self-root destination is rejected.

requirements.title: Encryption on by default, secrets from vault
requirements.description: Every destination is created encrypted by default. Repository passphrases and backend access keys are read from the vault resource at runtime and never written to config files or argv.

validation.notes: Assert repository status reports a non-null encryption algorithm; assert secrets resolved via vault, absent from persisted config.
